# Vimeo Downloader

> Full content index for Vimeo Downloader. Use this file when `/llms.txt` is too compact and an AI agent needs the main pages, language entrances and sitemap files.

## Pages

- [Home](https://vimeodownloader.app/): Online download tool and an overview of the Chrome extension: features, how it works, online tool versus extension, scope and limits, plans and FAQ.
- [Pricing](https://vimeodownloader.app/ext-pricing/): The Unlimited subscription for the Chrome extension.
- [About](https://vimeodownloader.app/about/): What the website and the extension each do, privacy principles and access boundaries.
- [Contact](https://vimeodownloader.app/contact/): Public support channel for account, download, extension, billing and privacy questions.
- [Terms of Service](https://vimeodownloader.app/terms/): Terms for using the website and the extension.
- [Privacy Policy](https://vimeodownloader.app/privacy/): What data is collected and how it is used.
- [Short LLMs index](https://vimeodownloader.app/llms.txt): Compact AI-readable summary of the website and its pages.

## Key Facts

- Product name: Vimeo Downloader.
- Supported source platform: Vimeo only (vimeo.com, www.vimeo.com, player.vimeo.com).
- Online tool: paste a public Vimeo link, no sign-in required; saves MP4 video.
- Chrome extension: Chrome and other Chromium browsers; saves MP4 video, M4A or MP3 audio, VTT subtitles and JPEG cover images, with a cross-tab download queue.
- Limits: does not bypass access controls, does not remove DRM, and is not affiliated with Vimeo, Inc.
- Language coverage: 14 website locales, English by default.
- Safety boundary: Vimeo Downloader never asks for Vimeo or Google passwords, verification codes, API credentials, or session files.
